Name: WF_PensiiFacultative - Import fisiere de la Fonduri

ActionParameters.Name: SqlQuery
ActionParameters.Value:
select 
 case 
        when lower(@Fisier) like '%ingo%' then 7990
        when lower(@Fisier) like '%ingc%' then 7991
        when lower(@Fisier) like '%alzm%' then 7992
        when lower(@Fisier) like '%alzv%' then 7993
        when lower(@Fisier) like '%bcrp%' then 7994
        when lower(@Fisier) like '%aviva%' then 7995
    end as CodBeneficiar

ActionParameters.Name: SqlQuery
ActionParameters.Value:
delete from app.PensieFacultativa
where CodSucursala = @CodSucursala
  and Anul = @Anul
  and Luna = @Luna
  and FieldId=[FisierExcel]

delete from app.Retinere
where TipRata = 7
  and CodSucursala = @CodSucursala
  and Anul = @Anul
  and Luna = @Luna
  --and FieldId=[FisierExcel]
  and CodBeneficiar = @CodBen

ActionParameters.Name: SqlQuery
ActionParameters.Value:
insert into app.Retinere
(
    TipRata,
    Marca,
    NumarCurent,
    CodBeneficiar,
    Rata,
    Dobanda,
    RestdePlata,
    NumarContract,
    FondRulment,
    CodSucursala,
    Judet,
    Luna,
    Anul,
    CreatedDate
)
select
    7,
    pf.Marca,
    --isnull(
    --    (select max(r.NumarCurent) + 1 
    --     from app.Retinere r 
    --     where r.Marca = pf.Marca),
    --    1
    --),
    1,
    pf.CodBeneficiar,
    pf.ContributieTotala,
    0,
    0,
    pf.Cont,
    pf.ContributieTotala,
    pf.CodSucursala,
    substring(pf.Marca,2,2),
    pf.Luna,
    pf.Anul,
    getdate()
from app.PensieFacultativa pf
where pf.CodSucursala = @CodSucursala
  and pf.Luna = @Luna
  and pf.Anul = @Anul
  and pf.CodBeneficiar = @CodBeneficiar
  --or  Fisier = @Fisier

  and not exists (
        select 1
        from app.Retinere r
        where r.Marca = pf.Marca
          and r.CodBeneficiar = pf.CodBeneficiar
          and r.Luna = pf.Luna
          and r.Anul = pf.Anul
          and r.TipRata = 7
)
